title: Non-trivial representations of knot groups (Kronheimer--Mrowka)
html: Kronheimer and Mrowka proved that the fundamental group of every non-trivial knot admits a non-trivial representation into \mathrm{SU}(2), and hence into \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C}). Consequently, every non-trivial knot type contributing to the fibre bundle carries a non-abelian gauge holonomy. Restricting to traceless elements of \mathrm{SU}(2) ensures the representation factors through the adjoint form.
